result.finding: Multi-stage Dockerfile with 2 stages. The final runtime image has approximately 9-11 layers: base eclipse-temurin:8-jre layers (~8-10) plus 1 COPY layer for the application JAR. Build-stage layers (2 RUN + 2 COPY) are discarded and do not appear in the final image.
evidence: FROM instructions: 2 (multi-stage build — stage 1: maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 AS build, stage 2: eclipse-temurin:8-jre)
Build stage layer-creating instructions: 2 RUN (mvn dependency:go-offline, mvn clean package), 2 COPY (pom.xml, src/)
Final stage layer-creating instructions: 1 COPY (--from=build app.jar) — build stage layers excluded
No additional RUN, ADD, or APT install instructions in the final stage
Single-command RUN instructions — no concatenation optimization needed
values: Build stage discarded layers: 4 (2 RUN + 2 COPY)
